name: Etching
summary: An intaglio print from a metal plate whose lines a needle draws through an acid-resistant ground and an acid then bites.
how: Coat the plate with a ground of wax, resin and asphalt and draw through it with a needle of 0.2–0.5 mm.
Bite the plate in acid in stages; stop out the light lines with varnish after 5–10 minutes and bite the dark lines again.
Ink the plate, wipe the surface with tarlatan, and leave a film of plate tone where a soft dark is needed.
Print on dampened paper on a roller press, so that the plate leaves a mark round the image.

origin.note: Urs Graf makes the first dated etching on an iron plate; armourers used acid to decorate metal before this.

adoptions.via: Rembrandt etches portraits, scenes and landscapes beside his painting and makes the etching a painter's medium.
